assets.purpose: visual concept, not a gameplay screenshot
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished game VFX design sheet for a Chinese ink and cut-paper mobile action game, landscape sheet with two clear panels titled only 'Lv3 墨阵' and 'Lv4 唤墨魁'. Flat stylized 2.5D, dark desaturated jade arena ground, paper ivory, cinnabar and restrained antique gold, no photorealism. Left: an imperfect hand drawn ink circle lies on ground, precise concentric ancient talisman formation opens inside it, short gold rune marks orbit, strong radial pulse and four ink crests attacking tiny red paper monsters within the circle. Right: SAME ink circle becomes a deep liquid ink pool, an imposing broad-shouldered half-body guardian made of flowing dark ink emerges, two massive hands gripping the pool rim, small luminous ivory mask eyes and gold calligraphic edge accents, one hand ready for a heavy downward slam, liquid curling back into pool. It is a benevolent mysterious ink guardian not horror. Readable dramatic silhouette, grounded low pool, impressive ritual awakening with finite sharp gold arcs, preserve lots of empty arena outside effects, avoid busy particles or full-screen flashes, avoid dragons fish tigers, no HUD. Include small peripheral detail sketches of an ink line intercepting a red projectile creating a round gold ripple. Production reference for implementing animated vector game effects, large clean forms and limited shading.

assets.purpose: body/hand sprite source; actual result arranged hand/body/hand; cropped and packed into a small atlas
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background, wide landscape layout with THREE equal separated columns and generous clear gaps, no text no labels no frames no background. Chinese ink and cut-paper mobile game, rich expressive hand-painted charcoal ink brush textures, opaque dark blue-black and muted jade forms with subtle antique gold brushstroke highlights and warm ivory details; crisp clean silhouette, flat stylized 2.5D, NOT photorealism, NO glowing neon. LEFT COLUMN: a complete broad-shouldered half-body ink guardian TORSO AND HEAD ONLY, no arms or hands, frontal three-quarter-free symmetric view, a large angular ivory ceremonial mask with two narrow dark eyes, small cinnabar forehead mark, majestic upward curling ink flame horns, layered flowing torn-ink mantle forming massive rounded shoulders, heavy chest with tasteful broad gold calligraphy curves, lower torso dissolves into liquid tapered ink ribbons. Should feel powerful, ancient, benevolent, not horror or skeletal. MIDDLE COLUMN: separate massive LEFT forearm and open clawed HAND of the same ink guardian, palm down, knuckles facing viewer, long curling charcoal ink fingers with elegant muted gold edges, short flowing forearm ending cleanly at wrist top, same flat painting style, entire hand fully visible. RIGHT COLUMN: matching mirrored RIGHT forearm and hand, same pose and size, entire silhouette visible. All three elements isolated and completely unconnected; no overlap between columns. Most detail and visual emphasis in large readable shoulder shapes and ivory mask, avoid thin wireframe outlines and flat unshaded vector polygons. Intended to cut three separate sprites and animate torso rise and independent hand slams over an ink pool, so NO pool, NO magic circle, NO terrain, NO enemies, NO cast shadows behind assets. Transparent empty pixels everywhere else.
